searchText: I see that multiple CL clients has issues with nimbusel and ethereumjs. It's very likely that the issues are on those ELs. Any chance to make this reporting smarter so that CLs are not flagged when the same EL has issues with most of the CLs? Otherwise folks will just start to ignore those reports. I understand that those ELs should react immidiatelly and fix everything, but I'm not sure that those smaller ELs have availability to do it.

I see that multiple CL clients has issues with nimbusel and ethereumjs. It's very likely that the issues are on those ELs. Any chance to make this reporting smarter so that CLs are not flagged when the same EL has issues with most of the CLs? Otherwise folks will just start to ignore those reports. 

I understand that those ELs should react immidiatelly and fix everything, but I'm not sure that those smaller ELs have availability to do it.
